add.text: Under Unity's 2026 pricing, Unity Personal is free up to $200,000 in revenue and funding, and Unity Pro costs $2,310 per seat per year when prepaid.
add.label: verified

add.text: The Godot engine is MIT-licensed and permits commercial games with no royalties or revenue thresholds.
add.label: verified

add.text: Unity IAP provides a unified first-party purchasing API that covers both the Apple App Store and Google Play.
add.label: verified

add.text: Godot's April 2026 mobile update lists plugin coverage, performance, testing and mobile workflows as areas that still need work.
add.label: verified

add.text: According to an AppRadar blog, Unity runs about 70% of top mobile games.
add.label: verified

add.text: For mobile games, Unity tends to suit heavier 3D on mid-range phones, while Godot suits 2D and lighter 3D.
add.label: agreed but unchecked

open_disputes.text: Whether Unity has first-party or official integrations with major ad networks, such as LevelPlay mediation, while Godot mostly relies on community plugins, is unconfirmed because the checker could not verify it.
Whether Godot's baseline Android export size is roughly 15–20 MB is unsettled, and no current build-size benchmark was found.
